messages:
Ellen: FYI — AcmeCorp sent a 12-page compliance questionnaire. They want SOC2 evidence, exportable audit logs, per-tenant retention up to 7 years, and EU-only data residency. Deadline for their procurement review: next Tue.
Sam: Thanks Ellen — can you drop the questionnaire and call out must-haves vs nice-to-haves?
AuditBot: uploaded file: https://files.redwood.internal/acme/audit-questionnaire-2026-03-18.pdf :page_facing_up: 
Ellen: P1 must-haves per customer email: SOC2 report & controls mapping, admin/audit log exports (CSV), contract clause for EU data residency, SLA uptime evidence. 7yr retention listed as a requirement but they noted it could be an optional extended retention add-on.
Priya: Quick take: SOC2 report + controls mapping we can provide from our attestation artifacts. CSV exports for admin/audit logs are doable but need to confirm which events they want (auth, API keys, model access, prompt metadata?).
Jorge: Support sees this pattern from 3 enterprise prospects this quarter — logs + retention is the blocker for procurement. If we can offer export + 3yr retention in contract, sales moves faster.
Nina (Legal): Legal note — default we can commit to 3 years retention in MSA. 7 years is a material change; requires IP/records/legal review and possibly higher indemnity/liability terms. Also need clarity on whether retention includes raw customer data, derived embeddings, or just request/response metadata.
Sam: Proposed triage/scoping (quick sketch):
- A: Deliver SOC2 artifacts and controls mapping (low dev effort, high impact) — acceptance: PDF + control matrix.
- B: Admin/audit log export endpoints (CSV download or S3 export) for selected events (auth, admin, billing, model-served events) — acceptance: sample CSV + API + example query UI.
- C: Per-tenant configurable retention policy (default 90d, contract option up to 7y) — discovery epic; acceptance: retention UI + enforcement + billing implications.
- D: Data residency (EU region pinning) — infra + deployment config; acceptance: customer org can be pinned to eu-1 with documented controls.
Priya: Rough engineering estimates: A ~1 day to package + security review; B ~2w (backend export + permissions + tests); C ~8w (storage + deletion pipeline + tests + audit); D ~3w infra + config, assuming region already supports required models. These are ballpark and need eng-runtime signoff.
Ellen: Sales context: AcmeCorp will sign if we cover SOC2 + EU residency + 3yr retention. They requested 7y but said they'd accept 3y initially if 7y is on the roadmap with timeline.
Sam: Decision call for product: Move A and B to high priority backlog items, create discovery for C (retention) and D (residency) with target milestones. Negotiate 3y in contract and propose 7y as paid add-on.
Jorge: I'll open the support intake ticket and attach examples of events the customer asked for. Also will request sample schema from Acme (they mentioned wanting prompt hashes and account IDs).
Priya: For B (export) — need spec for event set. Sample retention enforcement config we discussed:
```
# per-tenant retention example
tenant_id: acme-corp-001
default_retention_days: 90
max_retention_days_allowed: 2555  # ~7 years
enforce_delete_after_retention: true
export_endpoint: /v1/orgs/acme-corp-001/audit/export?from=...&to=...
```
Sam: Acceptance criteria (short):
- SOC2 artifacts: uploaded to customer portal, controls matrix mapped to questionnaire sections.
- Audit export: API + UI export, includes required event set, supports CSV and S3 destination, tested with sample from Acme.
- Retention discovery: show tech constraints, cost delta, legal sign-off path for >3yr.
- Residency: documented deployment steps and checklist for EU pinning.
Nina (Legal): Also capture requirements around subpoenas and legal holds — retention deletion must be suspendable if legal hold requested. We'll need a legal-hold flow design before committing to deletion timelines.
Sam: Next steps:
- Ellen: confirm which events Acme needs (EOD today).
- Jorge: create support intake + attach their questionnaire + sample fields (tomorrow).
- Priya: create preliminary engineering ticket for export + initial estimate; kickoff discovery for retention (this week).
- Nina: draft MSA amendment language for 3yr retention and optional extended retention add-on.
I'll create the product epic & link tickets. :thumbsup:
Ellen: On it. Thanks. :pray:
Priya: tagging eng-runtime for signoff @eng-runtime
Sam: tagging @sales-leads so they know negotiation approach.
AuditBot: reminder set: follow-up next Mon 09:00 to check progress.
